description: Late-return charge explained from the fee rules, not invented.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What happens if I bring it back a day late?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: There's a grace period of 29 minutes; past that you're charged a further rental day at the standard rate, plus a late-return fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: and if I don't turn up at all?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: A no-show is charged at one rental day and the booking is released.
